question: In India, the National Sports Day is celebrated on which date?
solution:
The correct answer is __**29th August**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **29th August** is celebrated as the National Sports Day in India.
 
• The day marks the birth anniversary of **Major Dhyan Chand**, one of the greatest hockey players in the history of the sport.
 
• Major Dhyan Chand's achievements in hockey earned India great international recognition, and he is often referred to as the "Wizard of Hockey".
 
• The National Sports Day is celebrated to honor his legacy and to promote sports and physical fitness across the country.
 
• On this day, various events and activities are organized nationwide, including sports competitions, award ceremonies, and fitness drives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand** was born on 29th August 1905 in Allahabad, India.
 
• He was part of the Indian hockey team that won gold medals in the Olympics in 1928, 1932, and 1936.
 
• In 1956, he was awarded the **Padma Bhushan**, India's third-highest civilian honor, for his contributions to sports.
 
• The National Sports Awards, including the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna, Arjuna Award, and Dronacharya Award**, are presented by the President of India on this day.
 
• The day aims to raise awareness about the importance of sports and physical activities in leading a healthy and active lifestyle.
